comments.author: kevin
comments.text:
Seems par for the course. Getting degrees in helping people seem to involve incredible amounts of work. But I’m sure it’ll pay off both financially and be emotionally rewarding job experience. Probably beats working the meat counter. Good Luck.

My fiance is in mental health counseling, it took 7 years but she’s almost doing what she wants to be doing.
